firm_data.firm_description: Liberty International Underwriters is a global specialty lines insurer. They provide a range of insurance products and services to businesses worldwide.

email.subject: AI for Liberty International Underwriters, built for global operations
email.body:
Hi Defne,

As COO of a global specialty lines insurer based in London, you're managing operations across multiple jurisdictions while keeping costs lean. That's exactly the challenge we're solving.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for professional services firms that need BigLaw-caliber work without the BigLaw headcount. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on precision, client trust, and operational efficiency.

We're helping insurance-adjacent firms automate contract review, document analysis, and compliance workflows. Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional leaders.

Worth a quick call to explore whether this fits Liberty's tech roadmap?

Vasu
Lucio
